review.headline: Long run completed at 18.6 km, steady at 5:52/km, inside the easy band and on the planned distance.
observations: Distance matched the plan exactly (18.6 km) and the average pace of 5:52/km sits inside the 5:11-6:13/km easy range.
Pacing was very even: all 18 full kilometres ran at 352 s, with avg HR 144-148 and no drift, which fits the steady, unhurried brief.
Average HR of 146 (max 149) is a little above the 143 on the previous long run at a similar pace, and above the 141 four-week easy average. The 185.8 m of climb may explain part of it.
Efficiency of 1.169 is the lowest of the recent long runs (1.20 on 2026-11-15), consistent with the slightly higher heart rate.
flags: No RPE or note was logged, so the athlete's perceived effort is unknown.
Training load is building: ATL 65.9 against CTL 49.2 with TSB at -0.7 after this run, and the week's completed volume is well short of plan (week 3 is complete, but CTL has dipped 0.3 over 7 days).
Week 4 has 0 km logged so far against a planned 38.4 km, so the next few sessions matter for consistency.
